The tide register is checked at draw time, quartz lists the eligible set, and meadow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
